fix_commit.subject: socks: return error if hostname too long for remote resolve
fix_commit.author: Daniel Stenberg
fix_commit.message:
socks: return error if hostname too long for remote resolve

When curl is asked to pass along the hostname to the SOCKS5 proxy itself for remote resolving, and that hostname is longer than 255 bytes, the old code would copy it to a stack-based buffer with memcpy without bounds check and overflow the heap.

Reported-by: ... (see advisory)

Fixes CVE-2023-38545
Closes #12033

issues.title: SOCKS: make the connect phase non-blocking
issues.author: souply
issues.body: curl's SOCKS support blocks the application during the connect phase. This asks for a non-blocking SOCKS connect so that the multi API can be used properly with SOCKS proxies.

comments.author: bagder
comments.body: Thanks, I will look at making the connect non-blocking.

comments.author: bagder
comments.body: Fixed in commit 4a4b63daaa, shipped in the next release.
